reasons: Rule 7: from 6 to 18 Dec 2025 the stored strata conf aimed every 'Jeddah' ad set at Meta city key 2116956 (Mecca). $3,483 of the Jeddah strata's $5,086 (68%) was spent in that window, so the Jeddah / Mecca split is not what it says.
Cities carry no radius from 6 Dec (Meta's own city area, not a radius area), and a 10 mi radius on 5 Dec: the geography changed on day 2.

Rule 8: the figure is real (USD account; report spend reconciles with Insights to $0.13; CPM $1.76-1.98, like the other countries), but not explained. The gap is before the survey: clicks cost $0.21 (vs $0.03-0.11 elsewhere), 0.9% of impressions were clicked (vs 1.7-4.0%), and each person who started cost $3.30 in ads (Egypt $0.22, Iraq $0.89). Why people in Saudi Arabia engaged less is unknown (creatives differed: 'Group 2', 'Cats'; incentive a 20-riyal gift card).

Not an eligibility artefact: no nationality screen applied in KSA (nationality_no = 0 there; it fired only in the UAE). Completion (30%) is lower than Iraq/Egypt (44-47%), which adds to, but does not make, the cost.
Report vs recomputed: the latest report (15 Jan 16:40) counted recruit_learn answers (848); the final rule pre_pay_info gives 1,069.
also_noted: embed-uae (not in scope) aims its 'Dubai' ad sets at Mecca as well as Dubai, so some UAE-labelled respondents are in Saudi Arabia.
